title: Penthouse Magazine March 1995 International Edition Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, March 1995 issue — "The International Magazine for Men." Features Pet of the Year Runner-Up, plus "Cybersex Blast-Off," and commentary on Robert Redford.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
